title: [Installer] Per-user upgrades plan related bundles twice and leave broken uninstall entries
author: LegendaryBlair

status.label: Installer mitigation design queued
status.detail: The duplicate Burn plan is supported by deterministic logs, an exact WiX issue, and a feasible BAFunctions seam, but mitigation still needs design review.

next_action.label: Develop Burn deduplication design
next_action.reason: Specify plan-lifetime identity tracking, callback behavior, rollback, and tests before approval.

judgment.rationale: The report includes deterministic logs, exact engine ownership, current dependency versions, and a product-side mitigation point. A generic ZIP would not change the design decision.
evidence: Burn logs show the same per-user bundle detected and planned twice; the first uninstall removes cache and the second fails with 0x80070003.
wixtoolset/issues#7675 describes the same HKCU registry-view duplication and remains open, assigned to robmen.
SilentFilesInUseBAFunctions overrides OnPlanBegin but has no OnPlanRelatedBundle deduplication.
judgment.recommended_action: Develop and adversary-review a mitigation that deduplicates repeated per-user bundle IDs during planning while preserving first occurrence, rollback, dependency-provider, and per-machine behavior.

issue_context.summary: Per-user upgrades plan the same related WiX bundle twice, so the second uninstall runs after its cached executable was removed and leaves broken Installed Apps entries.
known_information: The issue provides exact detection, planning, uninstall, cache-removal, and failure log evidence.
The external WiX issue matches the duplicate HKCU scan and is open.
PowerToys uses the affected WiX 5.0.2 toolset.
PowerToys ships a BAFunctions DLL with a plan-begin extension point.
inferences: A case-insensitive per-plan set keyed by bundle code is plausible, but callback ordering and rollback require verification.
Post-install registry cleanup is riskier than preventing the duplicate plan entry.
issue_context.analysis: The bot's generic ZIP request is not decision-changing because retained Burn logs identify the engine behavior. The next work is rigorous design and tests around the existing BAFunctions seam.
initial_investigation: Verified the external WiX issue body, state, assignee, and matching sequence.
Inspected SilentFilesInUseBAFunctions.cpp and found no related-bundle override.
Found no PowerToys fix PR linked to #50087.

information_gaps.information: Validated callback ordering and rollback behavior when suppressing the second OnPlanRelatedBundle occurrence.
information_gaps.why_needed: The mitigation must not suppress a legitimate operation or break restoration.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Use two increasing per-user bundles and forced-failure rollback cases during full design validation.
